infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used only to compute how the August 12, 2026 solar eclipse will look from where you are. It never leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is shown behind the AR sky view so the app can point you to where the eclipse is happening. No photos are taken or stored.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Device motion is used to detect where your phone is pointing in the AR sky view.
